product_version: Redis ZRANGE REV since 6.2; current Redis command docs and Cluster spec; Apache Flink stable docs, checked 2026-10-05
version_sensitive_claims: Q1: ZADD updates score, ZRANGE REV lists descending score, ZREVRANK returns zero-based rank; Redis Cluster replication is asynchronous.
Q2: equal-score members are ordered lexicographically; ZCOUNT counts members in score range, not distinct scores.
Q3: Flink watermarks are event-time progress markers, not a business finalization deadline.
Q5: Redis Cluster partitions by key hash slot; one Sorted Set remains a single key.
staleness_risks: Season transitions, deduplication and sharded rank are architecture examples rather than vendor guarantees.
Author semantic MCQ review and automatic gates only; independent blind review remains TODO.
notes: Redis Q2/Q11 cover basic Sorted Set operations; new topic adds tie policy, reliable event updates, seasonal lifecycle and global rank across shards.
